TC-06/S12.title: Step 5: a status changed by hand before the day roll is not changed by the roll (Hospital and Nursing Home)
TC-06/S12.detail: PW, local stack, Hospital and Nursing Home. Day 1 on a browser whose clock read Oct 14 22:59-23:00 JST, through the chart header's status control: A New Admission then Follow-up by hand; B New Admission at 22:59 then Consult by hand at 23:00 (both stored with 2026-10-14). Day 2 on the real clock: C set New Admission (new@2026-10-15), list opened (the lifecycle ran): A Follow-up, C New Admission. Day 3 for C (its stored day moved back one day), list opened: C Follow-up, A still Follow-up. Judged cells A and C pass in both contexts (5/5 each, incl. the day-1 setup). B recorded for Q2: it read Follow-up on day 2 (stored follow-up@2026-10-15), i.e. the build restarts the clock on every hand change and does not exempt a hand-set Consult.
